goal: Validate blocks in libbitcoinkernel without requiring a local on-disk chainstate database
Allow lightweight verifiers and external UTXO databases to validate block transactions directly
agreement: Broad concept support, but contested objections remain after a rebase (ajtowns, w0xlt)
Contested objection: caller callback enables non-deterministic lookups and drops UTXO changes (ajtowns)
Contested objection: script cache poisoning could let caller-supplied coins validate invalid blocks (w0xlt)
Contested objection: impossible coin confirmation heights can cause assertion crashes in release builds (w0xlt)
Unaddressed objection: assumevalid causes ancestor blocks to skip script checks (nervana21)

categories.name: kernel
why: P2 because it adds a major capability to libbitcoinkernel for block validation without an on-disk UTXO set
P2 because it advances API completeness for external consumers and lightweight verification tools

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it adds a new validation entry point that checks blocks against caller-supplied coins
P2 because it alters how block validation interacts with script caching and validity invariants
